visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a light blue ruffled dress, sits in what appears to be a classroom. Five elementary-aged children—two boys and three girls—stand behind her in a semi-circle. The setting is brightly lit with fluorescent ceiling lights, showing a chalkboard and classroom windows in the background. (2) The woman brings a silver flute to her lips and begins to play while the children listen intently. Animated icons representing 'Detective Conan' and other anime characters appear as overlays. A boy in a blue shirt raises his hand enthusiastically. (3) The scene continues with the woman playing different melodies. A girl in a white and red uniform covers her mouth in surprise, then smiles. The woman looks at the camera with a cheerful expression while holding the flute. (4) The woman plays a high-tempo melody. A girl in a green school uniform raises her hand to answer. Graphics for 'Oshi no Ko' appear on the screen. (5) Transitioning to the final segment, the woman plays another tune. The children are seen laughing and reacting. (6) The woman lowers her flute and engages in a joyful conversation with the children, smiling broadly and gesturing with her hands while the kids lean in to talk.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, energetic female voice greeting the audience in Traditional Chinese, accompanied by light background chatter from children. (2) A clear, melodic flute starts playing a recognizable anime theme (Detective Conan) with a medium tempo. The flute dominates the spectral brightness. (3) A sharp 'Ding' sound effect plays, followed by the female voice excitedly shouting 'Correct!' and laughing with the kids. (4) The flute melody shifts to another anime theme (Demon Slayer), characterized by more complex phrasing and higher pitch intensity. (5) Another 'Ding' sound effect triggers a transition back to the female speaker explaining the song title while children giggle in the background. (6) A high-tempo flute sequence starts, playing 'Idol' from Oshi no Ko. The acoustics are bright and dynamic. (7) The speaker interacts with a child who answered correctly, her tone is warm and humorous. (8) A final flute segment plays 'Blue Bird' from Naruto, ending with a celebratory vocal flourish from the children and the creator.
